claims: Anthony Edwards will not play in the Minnesota Timberwolves' game against the Houston Rockets on Wednesday, March 25, 2026.
Anthony Edwards is officially ruled out for the fifth consecutive game with right knee inflammation.
There is no official timetable for Anthony Edwards' return.
Anthony Edwards is dealing with the injury day-to-day.
Anthony Edwards is considered a possibility to return as soon as Saturday's game against the Detroit Pistons.
